source.name: Genoa CFC, 'bet365 Scores è lo Sleeve Sponsor'
source.quote: bet365 Scores è il nuovo Sleeve Sponsor per le stagioni sportive 2026/27 e 2027/28 in relazione alla prima squadra maschile
source.note: The club's announcement: a two-season sleeve deal (2026/27 and 2027/28) for the men's first team, brokered by Infront Sports; the logo goes on the left sleeve of the match shirts.

note: bet365's live-scores app rather than the gambling brand, as with Udinese, Fiorentina, Cagliari, Torino and Juventus. No reported deal value found.
